note:
Data in euros are given in the value of the latest statistical year.
Statistical unit: household (household population).
The figures for 1987-2004, 2009, 2013 and 2016-2019 are not fully comparable with each other. The method of the statistics changed significantly in 2009.
Median and quartiles are conditional on owning the asset. Mean is average over all households.
